title.en: How to Reserve Your World of Warcraft: Forever Character Name on October 27th
title.es: Cómo reservar tu nombre de personaje de World of Warcraft: Forever el 27 de octubre

summary.en: How to Reserve Your World of Warcraft: Forever Character Name on October 27th...
summary.es: Cómo reservar tu nombre de personaje de World of Warcraft: Forever el 27 de octubre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has revealed how players can reserve their character names in World of Warcraft: Forever on October 27th!

Starting on October 27th at 1:00 PM PDT, eligible players can create and reserve up to three characters across all the Rulesets!
Blizzard
View Original
Early Name Reservations for World of Warcraft: Forever are available from 27 October through 3 November, giving players an opportunity to secure the names that will become part of their adventures in Azeroth.

Name Reservation Start Times

  • Europe: 27 October at 18:00 CET
  • North America: 27 October at 13:00 PDT
  • Korea: 28 October at 07:00 KST
  • Taiwan: 28 October at 07:00 CST
During the reservation period, eligible players* can create and reserve names for up to three characters total across all Rulesets. This means that if you create two on a PvP Ruleset, you’ll only be able to create one more character in a Normal or Role-Play Ruleset. This restriction only applies to Early Name Reservation.

Prepare to Launch

  1. Make sure your graphics drivers are up to date.
  2. Download and install the Battle.net desktop app
  3. Open the Battle.net desktop app and allow it to update if needed.
  4. Select World of Warcraft from the list of games.
  5. In the Game Version menu above the Play button, select World of Warcraft: Forever, then select Install.
  6. Once installation is complete select Play and choose your Ruleset.
  7. Create up to 3 characters with your chosen name.
Choose the names that will carry your heroes into a new age and prepare for your adventures in World of Warcraft: Forever.
Players who pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or limited-time Warcraft Forever Collection will have access to WoW®: Forever Early Name Reservation from 27 October through 3 November. Character names will be available on a first-come, first-served basis, and desired names cannot be guaranteed.

For additional information on how character names work, check out the previously published Create a Name of Your Own in WoW: Forever article.

* Purchase of World of Warcraft: Forever Digital Upgrade or Collector’s Edition required. This benefit only applies to the specific WoW® account it was purchased for. WoW®: Forever Early Name Reservation will be available starting October 27 through November 3. Character names are limited to a first-come, first-serve basis, and desired names cannot be guaranteed.

title.es: Blizzard anuncia la fecha de cierre y la extensión de la beta de WoW: Forever

summary.en: Blizzard Announces Closing Date and Extension for WoW: Forever Beta...
summary.es: Blizzard anuncia la fecha de cierre y la extensión de WoW: Forever Beta...

contentHtml:
The World of Warcraft: Forever Beta has been extended an extra two days and will be going offline on Friday, October 23rd.

The WoW: Forever Beta has entered its final week, with the original closing date of the Beta being October 21st. In a new Blue Post, Blizzard has extended the WoW: Forever Beta an extra two days, and announced the new closing time of Friday, October 23rd at 10:00 AM Pacific time.

As the Forever Beta has now been extended past Thursday, it's possible that we get to see one more Beta build before the servers go down.
Blizzard
View Original
We plan to close the WoW Forever Beta … forever at 10:00 a.m. PDT on Friday, October 23.

Thank you very much for joining us. We’ll see you there!

Any player with a WoW account is eligible to play the WoW Forever Stress Test. No active subscription is needed.

How to Join

  1. Make sure your graphics drivers are up to date.
  2. Open the Battle.net desktop app and allow it to update if needed.
  3. Select World of Warcraft from the list of games.
  4. In the Game Version menu above the Play button, select World of Warcraft: Forever Stress Test under In Development, then select Install.
  5. Once installation is complete and the Stress Test begins, select Play and choose an available test realm.
  6. Create a new test character when available, enter the game, and join the test.
When we shut down the Stress Test, all Stress Test characters, including names, will be deleted and we will re-open the Beta.

title.es: Las presas de pesadilla se reparan y son la fuente más rápida de piedras venenosas ascendentes

summary.en: Nightmare Preys Hotfixed and Are Fastest Source of Ascendant Venomstones...
summary.es: Las presas de pesadilla se arreglaron y son la fuente más rápida de piedras venenosas ascendentes...

contentHtml:
Nightmare Prey now correctly drops Ascendant Venomstones and using the Soul Consumables makes Prey the fastest source of them!

Season 2 Delves GuidePrey Guide

Ascendant Venomstones from Prey

When the NA servers went live earlier today, Kith'ix and Nightmare Prey did not drop Ascendant Venomstones. This now appears to have been fixed, and your first two Nightmare Preys a week will grant you a Preyhunter's Champion Chest, containing a Ascendant Venomstone.

Soul Consumables

If you've been doing Prey content during Season 2, you probably have unlocked the Afflicted Soul and Tormented Soul items. These drop from Delves and instantly summon the boss during a Nightmare Prey, while also granting a bonus Preyhunter's Champion Chest or Preyhunter's Hero Chest chest on completion.



These bonus chests always drop one Preyhunter's Champion Chest, allowing you to get one bonus Ascendant Venomstone for very little work! If you use a soul consumable and it's one of your first two Nightmare Preys of the week, congratulations on two easy Ascendant Venomstones in about a minute.


2 Ascendant Venomstones for just over a minute of work.


The only downside is that there is a limited number of Ascendant Venomstones available from Prey. You have a maximum of 2 Nightmare Preys that drop Venomstones directly and limited by the number of soul consumables that you have. However, these items are Warbound, so you can send them over from other characters.

title.en: [Updated] Ascendant Venomstones Bugged and Not Dropping from Blizzard Noted Sources
title.es: [Actualizado] Piedras venenosas ascendentes detectadas y que no caen de fuentes de Blizzard

summary.en: [Updated] Ascendant Venomstones Bugged and Not Dropping from Blizzard Noted Sources...
summary.es: [Actualizado] Piedras de veneno ascendentes grabadas y no saliendo de fuentes de Blizzard...

contentHtml:
Ascendant Venomstones are now available and players have noticed that some drop sources are bugged and not dropping them.

Hotfixes have gone out that fix the issues. The original article has been left below for archival purposes, but we've added a new section above with the list of drop sources.

How to Farm Ascendant Venomstones

After the hotfixes, make sure you turn in the quest and Ascendant Venomstone correctly drop from:
  • Tier 11 Bountiful Delve Chests
  • Tier 11 Labyrinth (3 per full clear)
  • Heroic Nymrissa Wavecaller
  • Heroic Kith'ix
  • Heroic Venomous Abyss bosses
  • First 2 Nightmare Prey Runs
  • Bonus Chest from Afflicted Soul and Tormented Souls on Nightmare Prey
  • Mythic+ 10 or higher.

Original Article

If you've completed the Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom quest, Orin Straylight at the Silvermoon Catalyst will grant you the Ascending with Venomstones quest, which can be turned in immediately. This will unlock Ascendant Venomstone across your Warband and give you your first Ascendant Venomstone, but can only be completed once per account.

 


Blizzard described how to get Ascendant Venomstones in their official Patch Notes.
Blizzard
View Original
Completing this quest will empower defenders of the realm to acquire Ascendant Venomstones, which drop from every Heroic or Mythic raid boss, Mythic+ Keystone dungeons at +10 and above, Tier 11 Bountiful Delves, and Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests.
Players have now discovered that some of these sources are not currently dropping Venomstones as intended:
  • Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests are NOT dropping Ascendant Venomstones.
  • Heroic Kith'ix is NOT dropping Ascendant Venomstones.
We've confirmed that the following are dropping Ascendant Venomstones:
  • Tier 11 Bountiful Delve Chests (includes Labyrinth ending)
  • Heroic Nymrissa Wavecaller
  • Heroic Venomous Abyss bosses

title.en: Learn More About the WoW: Forever Raids and Attunements
title.es: Más información sobre el WoW: Incursiones y afinaciones permanentes

summary.en: Learn More About the WoW: Forever Raids and Attunements...
summary.es: Obtenga más información sobre el WoW: Incursiones y afinaciones eternas...

contentHtml:
Learn about the three new raids coming in WoW: Forever and details about the Onyxia attunement!
Blizzard
View Original
World of Warcraft: Forever invites adventurers to journey deeper into Azeroth, where familiar places hold new challenges and stories waiting to be discovered. On December 9, level 60 players can put their preparation, teamwork, and mastery of their classes to the test in three raids: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, and Onyxia’s Lair.

Raid Quick Facts

The Barrow Deeps
  • Location: Within Mount Hyjal, with multiple entrances connected through Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold
  • Level: 60
  • Raid Size: 10 players
Hyjal Summit
  • Location: Summit of Mount Hyjal near the World Tree Nordrassil
  • Level: 60
  • Raid Size: 20 players
Onyxia’s Lair
  • Location: Dustwallow Marsh
  • Level: 60
  • Raid Size: 40 players

Descend into The Barrow Deeps


Hidden beneath Kalimdor, the Barrow Deeps is a maximum-level raid for 10 players. The prison once held Illidan Stormrage for 10,000 years, but its dark passages have been opened. Now, players will descend into the fabled prison to learn what became of those left behind—and how the wardens plan to contain the danger below.
   
Entrances connected to Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold give raiders multiple paths into Barrow Deeps. Inside, 10-player groups will face eight bosses as they explore the prison’s depths.

Climb to the Peak of Hyjal Summit


At the peak of Mount Hyjal near the World Tree Nordrassil, Hyjal Summit features 13 bosses and begins with a battle against an ancient guardian. From there, raid groups can choose from multiple paths across the mountain, exploring ruins above and below ground as they confront the forces threatening Hyjal and open the way to the final encounters.

Choose your route, coordinate with your raid, and uncover what waits across one of Warcraft’s most iconic locations.

Face the Flames in Onyxia’s Lair


Deep in Dustwallow Marsh, Onyxia’s Lair is a level 60 raid for 40 players. Onyxia, a dragon of the Black Dragonflight and the younger sister of Nefarian, guards her brood here while working to manipulate Azeroth’s mortal races.

Onyxia’s three-phase encounter turns up the heat with powerful fire attacks that can punish an unprepared raid. Players should build their fire resistance before entering, then be ready to reposition and work together as the battle shifts around them. Designed for level 60 players, Onyxia’s Lair requires each member of the raid to carry the Drakefire Amulet to enter.

Get Attuned to Onyxia’s Lair

Before heading to Onyxia’s Lair, each player will need to earn the Drakefire Amulet through a faction-specific attunement questline. Start early, bring a few friends for the elite quests, and leave plenty of time for several trips into high-level dungeons.

Here’s a step-by-step guide through the series of quests you’ll need to follow.
  • Alliance
  • Horde
  1. Beginning in the Burning Steppes, you’ll pick up the quest “Dragonkin Menace” from Helendis Riverhorn.
  2. Helendis will then send you on the first of a series of six quests all named “The True Masters” to investigate the Black Dragonflight’s influence on the Blackrock orc clan.
  3. Follow the chain to Marshal Maxwell at Morgan’s Vigil in the Burning Steppes, who will send you into Blackrock Depths to recover Marshal Windsor—or proof of his demise—in “Marshal Windsor.”
  4. Windsor sends you back to Marshal Maxwell in “Abandoned Hope.”
  5. Find the item A Crumpled Up Note off of enemies in the Blackrock Depths dungeon, which starts the quest “A Crumpled Up Note.”
    Bring the note to Marshal Windsor in his cell in Blackrock Depths.
  6. In “A Shred of Hope” retrieve Windsor’s lost information from Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge in Blackrock Depths.
  7. Help Windsor escape Blackrock Depths in “Jail Break!” And return to Marshal Maxwell at Morgan’s Vigil in the Burning Steppes.
  8. Marshal Maxwell sends you to Stormwind in “Stormwind Rendezvous” to Squire Rower at the city gates. Speak with him to beckon Marshal Windsor.
  9. Gather allies to complete “The Great Masquerade” in Stormwind. Speak with Squire Rowe at the city gates if Windsor is not present.
  10. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon will send you on “The Dragon’s Eye” to hunt across Azeroth for someone capable of helping you.
They will send you through Upper Blackrock Spire in “Drakefire Amulet” take the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath and receive the Drakefire Amulet.
  1. In the Badlands, you’ll begin your journey with the quest “Blood and Thunder” from Warlord Goretooth in Kargath.
  2. This leads directly to the quest “Warlord’s Command”, which will take you throughout Lower Blackrock Spire.
  3. Goretooth will then send you to report to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar, then to seek council with Thrall.
  4. In “For the Horde!” Journey back into Lower Blackrock Spire to claim the head of Warchief Rend Blackhand for Thrall.
  5. Listen to Thrall’s discoveries during “What the Wind Carries”, then seek Rexxar wandering the roads of Desolace for “The Champion of the Horde.”
  6. Rexxar will direct you to deliver his testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands during “The Testament of Rexxar.”
  7. After speaking with Myranda, she will give you the quest “Oculus Illusions” to obtain Black Dragonspawn Eyes.
  8. Use your Amulet of Draconic Subversion in “Emberstrife” to seek out the ancient drake Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh.
  9. Emberstrife will test your skills in four quests each beginning with “The Test of Skulls,” bringing him the skulls of the named dragons he sends you to face. All in all, you’ll face Scryer, Somnus, Chronalis, and Axtroz.
  10. Emberstrife will give you the Dull Drakefire Amulet in “Ascension...” Bring it back to Rexxar roaming in Desolace.
  11. Rexxar sends you to Upper Blackrock Spire in “Blood of the Black Dragon Champion” to take the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath.
  12. Return to Rexxar to receive the Drakefire Amulet.
Before you enter: Make sure the Drakefire Amulet is in your inventory. It does not need to be equipped to enter Onyxia’s Lair.

Prepare for the First Raids

Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, and Onyxia’s Lair unlock on December 9, giving players time after launch to reach level 60 and prepare their groups. Whether you plan to explore Mount Hyjal with 10 or 20 players or face Onyxia with a full group of 40, choose the raid that fits your group and start getting ready. With all raids currently planned to reset each week, you can settle into a consistent schedule and return with your group for another run.

title.en: Despite Bugs, Over 150,000 Players Defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan During First Week of Patch 12.1.5
title.es: A pesar de los errores, más de 150 000 jugadores derrotaron al Kindo'jan de nivel 11 durante la primera semana del parche 12.1.5

summary.en: Despite Bugs, Over 150,000 Players Defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan During First Week of Patch 12.1.5...
summary.es: A pesar de los errores, más de 150.000 jugadores derrotaron al Kindo'jan de nivel 11 durante la primera semana del parche 12.1.5...

contentHtml:
Despite all the Labyrinth bugs, over 150,000 players have defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan during the first week of Patch 12.1.5, and there's still another week to go!

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan was released in Patch 12.1.5 with the limited-time Fabled Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan achievement. Similar to previous Nemesis bosses, this achievement is awarded to anyone who defeats Kindo'jan during the initial week of the Patch, but has since been extended an additional week due to many, many bugs in Labyrinths.

Unlike previous, traditional Nemeses, you can't just walk in and fight Kindo'jan. He becomes available after all 9 chambers of the Labyrinth are completed, which usually takes at least 45 to 60 minutes, and there are no save points in the run. On the upside, as players need to unlock all 9 chambers, they are actually able to acquire an insane amount of stats from Mislaid Curiosities, collect Hexmasks for bonus damage, and pick up Conduits before fighting the boss, which likely makes this boss much easier than intended. Many players have claimed to kill the boss in less than 90 seconds - before the Intermission!

 


With all these changes to the typical Nemesis boss formula, over 150,000 players have now defeated Tier 11 Kindo'jan during the first week of Patch 12.1.5 across both NA and EU servers. NA has over 70k kills, while EU has over 82k kills, and there's now another week to go.

 


We'll have to see how many players will claim the Fabled: Let Me Solo Him achievement and the %s, Fabled Vanquisher of The First Hash'ey title after the second week.
